main_text.head: IN OBITVM ILLVSTRISS. ET INVICTI PRINCIPIS EXCEL. MEMOR. MAVRICII, DEI GRATIA PRINCIPIS AVRIACI, COMITIS NASSOVIÆ, &c.

p.i: Habita ex publico mandato XIX Septemb. CIƆ IƆ C XXV.

main_text.head: ORATIO I.

p.i: Princeps Celsissime, Illustrissimi Comites, Nobilissimi Patriæ Proceres, Magnifice Rector, Amplissimi Curatores, Invicta hujus Vrbis Consules ac Magistratus, Reverendi ac Clarissimi Collegæ, Doctores venerandi, Ecclesiastæ Reverendi, Generosa Iuuentutis Nobilissimæ Corona,

main_text.p: QVOD omnis cogitet memoria, posteritas loquatur, die hujus mensis decimo & sexto, quem, cum fastis eximi non possit, atrum nobis ac funestum patriæque habendum judico, Mauritium Nassovium, quod nomen dignitates titulosque non admittit quia omnes antecessit, Patriæ Parentes, Magistratus ac Nobilitas, Miles ac Prætoriç cohortes, omnis populus, plebs omnis, mœsta, squallida, dejecta, ad Parentis tumulum, seu potius trophæum, vel secuta fuit vel deduxit. Luctum publicum, mœrentis Patriæ imaginem, orbitatis, solitudinis ac vastitatis
main_text.notes: Drop cap "Q" is an ornamented woodcut initial, read as Q. Catchword-like "A" at foot is a signature mark. The word "ftitatis" at the foot right is the continuation of "vastitatis" split across the line end with the signature; the first letters are read as "vastitatis" in the text above. Some words are uncertain due to print quality.
